title: PowerPoint on Mac: reference a Teams meeting or chat when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Pass: the roadmap facts, documented user-permission boundary, and existing licence and transcription controls are supported. The statement that this option creates a new file needs narrowing, and minor citation and checklist corrections remain.

claims.where: What's changing: user steps; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions

claims.quote: Enter a prompt that references the Teams meeting or chat you want to use in your presentation.

claims.where: What's changing: user steps; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Pressing Enter makes Copilot create a presentation using the referenced Teams content.
claims.quote: Press Enter. Copilot will create a presentation using the referenced Teams content.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The release note describes referencing meetings and chat messages securely during presentation creation.
claims.quote: This integration supports referencing meetings and chat messages securely within the presentation creation process.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The release-note entry itself gives no permission details.
claims.quote: Searched: read the full 555885 entry in Microsoft 365 Copilot release notes; it says 'securely' but gives no permission rule. The separate privacy page does document user view permissions, as the briefing reports.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The release-note entry does not identify which meeting content, such as a transcript, is read.
claims.quote: Searched: read the complete 555885 release-note entry; searched 'PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat transcript recording permissions prerequisites sign in consent'; no meeting-content format is specified for this option.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the default or an administrator enablement requirement for this particular referencing option.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Agent Mode Teams meeting chat admin policy enable disable default' and 'PowerPoint referencing chat default'; read record, release entry, overview, requirements and Edit with Copilot. The latter states Copilot's general default, not this option's.

claims.where: What's changing: feature documentation
claims.claim: No feature-specific Microsoft Learn page beyond the release-note entry was found.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat 555885 default license transcript' and 'Agent Mode in PowerPoint'; opened release notes, overview, requirements and wordexcelppt-agents. The agents page describes agents in the Copilot app, not this option.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: No option-specific change to sign-in, consent or admin roles is described.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat transcript recording permissions prerequisites sign in consent'; opened release notes, requirements, privacy and wordexcelppt-agents. No such change is stated for referencing Teams content in PowerPoint.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The release-note steps describe no background or scheduled action.
claims.quote: Searched: read the complete 555885 release-note entry and its Try this steps; they describe opening Copilot, entering a reference prompt and pressing Enter, with no background or scheduling step.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: permission-boundary test
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which the individual user has at least view permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, second bullet
claims.claim: The resulting deck is a new file.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Copilot new file'; read release entry, Create a new presentation with Copilot and July 22, 2025 release-note excerpts. New-file text is qualified to starting from an existing presentation; this option's entry says only that it creates a presentation.
claims.fix: Replace 'The resulting deck is a new file.' with 'Copilot creates a presentation using the referenced Teams content.' as stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/release-notes#july-01,-2026.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[1].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft's requirements page says to configure transcription or recording to let Copilot reference meeting content after a meeting ends.
claims.quote: To allow Copilot to reference meeting content after a meeting ends, configure transcription or recording.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether this specific PowerPoint option reads or requires a saved meeting transcript.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Teams presentation transcript' and the Agent Mode transcript/prerequisites query; read release entry, requirements, transcription page, privacy and Edit with Copilot. General post-meeting requirements are stated, but this option's content source is not.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The licence assignment route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. ... Select the row of the user ... select Licenses and Apps. ... Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns the chosen licence using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. ... Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least a License or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The meeting transcription setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true permits transcription through the selected Teams meeting policy.
claims.quote: To allow specific users in your organization to transcribe ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Governance controls table and notes
claims.claim: The meeting transcription policy controls transcription for meetings and group calls by users with that policy.
claims.quote: To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: Governance controls: organizer Copilot setting
claims.claim: When organizers turn off Copilot in Teams meetings and events, recording and transcription are also turned off.
claims.quote: When organizers turn off Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events, recording and transcription are also turned off.

claims.where: Governance controls: transcript storage
claims.claim: Transcripts are stored together with meeting recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint storage.
claims.quote: Transcripts are stored together with meeting recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint storage.

claims.where: Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The release-note entry names no admin setting for this option.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Agent Mode Teams meeting chat admin policy enable disable default' and 'PowerPoint Agent Mode admin controls'; read the full feature entry. It names user prompt steps, not an admin setting for this option.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; rationale: risk

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The transcription row governs Teams transcription rather than configuring the individual PowerPoint referencing option.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, third bullet; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist's deck labelling and sharing control has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Decide how decks built from meetings and chats should be labelled and shared ... The two rows in the table are ... one decides who holds the Copilot add-on licence, the other whether Teams meeting transcription is allowed.
claims.fix: The Before rollout step about deck labelling and sharing has no controls-table row. Remove that bullet to resolve the checklist/table mismatch without adding a control row.
